title: eriogonum campanulatum subsp. brevicaule
intro: Eriogonum campanulatum subsp. brevicaule, commonly known as the Mountain Buckwheat, is a flowering plant species native to the western coast of North America. As a medicinal herb, the Mountain Buckwheat is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, likely due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential uses of Eriogonum campanulatum subsp. brevicaule.
